svg.title: Dollhouse plate: the linen cupboard
svg.desc: The upstairs landing at night, drawn large: the linen cupboard cut open, its shelves of folded sheets and rolled tissue above a dark floor where a heap is only ten points of light, a chair wedged under the knob outside, and the hall light on.
svg.text: PLATE III. THE LINEN CUPBOARD, WITH THE CHAIR
